## 2. Core Electrical Services & Pricing Matrix (2026 Rates)

| Service | Price Range | Duration | Key Requirements & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Level 2 EV Charger Install** | $350 – $900 | 2 – 4 hours | 50A/60A dedicated circuit, hardwired or NEMA 14-50 outlet. Eligible for LADWP $500 rebate & 30% Federal 30C tax credit. |
| **Panel Upgrade (100A to 200A)** | $2,500 – $4,500 | 4 – 8 hours | LADBS permit required, LADWP service pull coordination. Required for EV chargers, heat pumps, solar. |
| **Federal Pacific / Zinsco Replacement** | $2,800 – $4,800 | 6 – 8 hours | Hazardous panel replacement. Recommended by fire departments & insurers. |
| **Whole-Home Rewiring** | $8,000 – $18,000 | 3 – 7 days | Replaces unsafe knob-and-tube or ungrounded aluminum wiring in pre-1960 homes. |
| **Recessed Lighting Installation** | $125 – $250 / fixture | 1 day | Ultra-thin LED wafer lights or can lights with IC rating for insulated ceilings. |
| **Electrical Troubleshooting & Repair** | $150 – $350 | 1 – 2 hours | Circuit breaker tripping, outlet failure, burning odors, flickering lights. |
| **Commercial Tenant Improvements** | Custom Quote | Varies | 200A–400A 3-phase power, LED retrofits, commercial EV fleet charging. |

---

## 3. Regulatory Compliance & Municipal Procedures

### Los Angeles Department of Building & Safety (LADBS)
- Electrical permits are mandatory for all panel replacements, EV charger dedicated circuits, subpanels, and whole-home rewiring.
- AMY Electric issues e-Permits directly through LADBS e-Permit portal and coordinates final municipal inspection.

### LADWP Utility Coordination
- For 200A service upgrades, LADWP disconnect/reconnect (pulling service drops) is coordinated by AMY Electric.
- Rebates: LADWP ChargeUp LA program provides residential rebates up to $500 for Level 2 charger installation.
